notes.title: A prequel to Grim Quest is coming soon!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341030/Grim_Tides__Old_School_RPG/

Grim Tides is a prequel to Grim Quest, set in the same world more than a thousand years in the past, and explores events that led to the Tearing and the fall of the Old Empire.

While the game follows the same overall formula of its predecessor, there are many new features to look forward to, for example:

- character attributes and perks
- brand new spell & skill trees
- more equipment slots (total of 8)
- ship & crew management and naval combat
- arena combat encounters & bosses
- much more detailed art style for enemies, items etc.
- abundance of lore and a rich storyline

Visit the Steam page of the game to find out more!

notes.title: Advanced Combat Mode
notes.content:
Working on an advanced combat mode! To keep the story short: you get 2 actions per turn, while all enemies' health is doubled to offset the advantage. In theory, this should result in a more dynamic and tactical experience, and open opportunities for new builds and strategies. 

This will be a togglable option when starting a new game, so old characters won't be affected. What do you think about the idea? Any suggestions?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42050967/f62c3408016715b30ea90e136cf75345b811cee3.png[/img]

notes.title: Initial Release
notes.content:
It's not an april's fools joke, [b]Grim Quest[/b] is launching today!

A free [b]DEMO[/b] is available alongside the full release, and I highly suggest you give it a try to get a taste of the game before deciding if it's something that you would enjoy. Dig in, and please let me know how you feel about it. Happy dungenoneering :)
